# Prep

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(rtracklayer)

library(DiffBind)
library(GenomicFeatures)

library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Loading data
```{r}

load("/path/to/project/R_analysis/2.Diffbind/data/diffbind_analyse_workspace_2v2.RData")
```



## Getting peaks of interest
```{r}

padj_threshold <- 0.05

get_sig_gr <- function(dba_obj, padj = padj_threshold) {
  #dba_obj = dbObj_RLEbackground_list[[1]]
  gr <- dba.report(dba_obj, th = padj)
  gr[seqnames(gr) %in% paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y"))]
}

n_comparisons <- length(dbObj_RLEbackground_list)  # should be 6

peak_results <- vector("list", n_comparisons)

for (i in seq_len(n_comparisons)) {

  bg_gr      <- get_sig_gr(dbObj_RLEbackground_list[[i]], padj_threshold)
  rpkm_gr    <- get_sig_gr(dbObj_RPKMnorm_list[[i]],      padj_threshold)
  dm6_gr     <- get_sig_gr(dbObj_dm6norm_list[[i]],       padj_threshold)
  sacCer3_gr <- get_sig_gr(dbObj_sacCer3norm_list[[i]],   padj_threshold)

  union_bg_rpkm     <- GenomicRanges::reduce(append(bg_gr, rpkm_gr),     ignore.strand = TRUE)
  union_dm6_sacCer3 <- GenomicRanges::reduce(append(dm6_gr, sacCer3_gr), ignore.strand = TRUE)

  peak_results[[i]] <- subsetByOverlaps(union_bg_rpkm, union_dm6_sacCer3, invert = TRUE)
}

```



# Saving peak set
```{r}

# Give each comparison a name for the output file — adjust to match your actual comparisons
comparison_names <- names(dbObj_RLEbackground_list)
if (is.null(comparison_names)) {
  comparison_names <- paste0("comparison", seq_len(n_comparisons))
}

for (i in seq_len(n_comparisons)) {


  comparison_name <- sample_information[rand_combos_2[i, ] %>% unlist, "Factor"] %>%
    unique() %>%
    paste(collapse = "_")
  result_df <- as.data.frame(peak_results[[i]])

  out_file <- paste0("./peaksets/",comparison_name, "_bg_rpkm_not_dm6_sacCer3.bed")

  write.table(
    result_df[, c("seqnames", "start", "end", "strand")],
    file      = out_file,
    sep       = "\t",
    quote     = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
  )
}
```
